summary: Camp listing in Idaho County, ID, dated 1931 (c.1930 in one source) and abandoned in 1939; sources disagree on the forest and none describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1939; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

events.note: Listed as a camp (no structure described); Forest Lookouts gives c.1930

evidence.supports: Payette National Forest, as listed by Forest Lookouts
index lists Meadow Creek, Idaho County, as Camp Abandoned
Valley County Meadow Creek is standing and NHLR-registered
evidence.quote: Meadow Creek Valley 44.86819 -115.38900 Ground Standing NHLR US 944, ID 98

evidence.supports: Valley County lookout on the NHLR

evidence.quote: built in 1933, is available for emergencies

corrections.why: The index lists this site as Camp Abandoned. No source says a structure was removed or destroyed.
Two sources name the Nez Perce National Forest; only Forest Lookouts (cite 3) names Payette. The disagreement is unresolved, so a human should confirm.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives an approximate c.1930 date; the two detailed sources give 1931 for the same camp.

notes_for_editor: The record's name collides with a different lookout: Meadow Creek Lookout in Valley County (NHLR US 944, ID 98) is standing and built in 1933. Keep the two apart. The record's coordinates (45.82788, -115.0239) differ from the firelookout.org index (45.81844, -115.14929) by roughly 10 km; neither was checked against a map. The forest is disputed (Nez Perce in two sources, Payette in one). The record's kind 'unknown' should probably read camp. No staffing record, photo or site description was found.
